'''Dyre''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] living during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="DB" /> Dyre<ref name="SM1" /> was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], and stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] fully-grown.<ref name="DB" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Dyre was assigned, along with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lock (clone trooper)|Lock]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]], to a [[Mission to Kynachi|mission]] to [[Kynachi]]. Upon arrival, their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was ambushed and destroyed by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Dyre's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] crashed on the planet. He was later killed in an ambush by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s.<ref name="SM1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dyre appears in [[Ryder Windham]]'s young readers novel, ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''.
